LanguageData.BloodTransfusion.description: Use blood packs to reduce the effects of blood loss. Each blood pack used recovers 35% blood loss. The operation will also restore blood supply to vampiric individuals.
LanguageData.ExtractHemogenPack.description: Extract a blood pack from the target. The operation will fail to produce a blood pack if the target does not have enough blood.\n\nBlood packs can be administered to others to reduce blood loss or to satiate those who feed on blood.
LanguageData.ExtractHemogenPack.label: extract blood pack
